blogs.title: From 4K to 2 Million: Inside LongRoPE’s Record-Breaking Context Window
blogs.description: A plain-language tour of why context windows matter, what breaks when you push them, and how LongRoPE gets to a 2,048,000-token window with only ~1k fine-tuning steps at 256k length. Covers the three key ideas: smarter positional interpolation, a progressive extension strategy, and short-context recovery.

blogs.title: The Non-Uniform Secret: How LongRoPE Rewrites Positional Interpolation
blogs.description: Explains the two non-uniformities LongRoPE exploits: different RoPE dimensions need different scaling, and early tokens should be preserved. Walks through the evolutionary search that finds per-dimension rescale factors and a starting-token threshold, plus a monotonic constraint that makes the search efficient. Shows how this alone enables up to 8x extension without fine-tuning.

blogs.title: Stepwise to 2M: LongRoPE’s Progressive Extension, Explained
blogs.description: Breaks down the recipe to reach 2,048k tokens: search for 128k/256k, fine-tune briefly at 256k (400+600 steps), then run a second search to jump to 2,048k without more fine-tuning. Clarifies why avoiding direct training on million-token sequences saves compute and improves stability.

blogs.title: Don’t Break the Short Context: Recovering 4k–8k Quality After Going Long
blogs.description: Why extending to extreme lengths can crowd positions and hurt short-context performance, and how LongRoPE readjusts RoPE for 4k and 8k via an extra search. Covers dynamic switching at inference so the model stays strong on everyday tasks.

blogs.title: Proof in Numbers: LongRoPE’s Perplexity and Passkey Wins
blogs.description: Summarizes the results: low perplexity from 4k up to 2,048k on long books, over 90% passkey retrieval accuracy across lengths for LLaMA2 (ft=256k), and competitive scores on standard short-context benchmarks. Compares against PI, NTK, and YaRN to show consistent gains.

blogs.title: RoPE to LongRoPE: Positional Embeddings Made Simple
blogs.description: A gentle intro to RoPE: what rotary position embeddings are, how interpolation vs. extrapolation changes token spacing, and why naive linear scaling crowds positions. Builds intuition for LongRoPE’s per-dimension scaling and early-token preservation.

blogs.title: LongRoPE vs. PI, NTK, and YaRN: What’s New and Why It Scales
blogs.description: A comparative look at prior methods: linear PI’s crowding, NTK’s limited non-uniformity, YaRN’s hand-crafted groups, and their typical 2–4x non-FT ceilings. Shows how LongRoPE’s search-driven, finer-grained scaling and progressive strategy push to 2,048k while keeping short-context quality competitive.

blogs.title: Engineer’s Guide: Extending LLaMA2 and Mistral With LongRoPE
blogs.description: A pragmatic walkthrough for practitioners: minimal architecture changes (RoPE only), reuse of existing kernels/optimizations, search hyperparameters, compute tips, and how to apply the progressive extension and short-context recovery in your own stack.
